subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms meets across a small table to finalize an international deal: one hand presents a wax-sealed document folder while the other offers a pen, mid-handoff. A small teal desk globe and two abstract color-block pennant flags (no real national symbols) sit nearby, signaling global reach. The scene reads as confident, respectful cross-border dealmaking.
